proposed_comments.title: Dispose the outgoing email previewer on error fallback
proposed_comments.out_of_diff_reason: The required disposal belongs in the existing FilePreview.Previewer_PropertyChanged error-fallback owner, which has no current RIGHT-side diff anchor. Adding disposal only inside the new EmailPreviewer does not make that existing owner invoke it.
proposed_comments.body:
**[P2] Dispose the outgoing email previewer on error fallback**

**Affected code:** `src/modules/peek/Peek.FilePreviewer/FilePreview.xaml.cs`, `Previewer_PropertyChanged`, together with `PreviewBrowser_NavigationCompleted` and `EmailPreviewer.Dispose`.

**Problem:** A failed browser navigation after the email HTML has been created sets the previewer state to `Error`. The fallback handler replaces `Previewer` with the default previewer without disposing the outgoing instance. `OnPreviewerChanging` clears sources and removes handlers, but does not call `Dispose`. Consequently this path bypasses the new email previewer's `_tempFile` cleanup. This is specifically the post-file-creation failure path, not every email parsing error.

**Why it matters:** The new email previewer relies on disposal to remove its generated HTML. Normal item-change disposal does not cover this replacement, and a later unrelated browser previewer's directory cleanup is not guaranteed to run.

**Suggested change:**
1. Capture the outgoing previewer before assigning the default.
2. Assign the replacement first, so `OnPreviewerChanging` clears the browser source and detaches the old handlers.
3. Dispose the captured instance before awaiting the replacement load:

```csharp
var previousPreviewer = Previewer;
Previewer = previewerFactory.CreateDefaultPreviewer(Item);
(previousPreviewer as IDisposable)?.Dispose();
await UpdatePreviewAsync(_cancellationTokenSource.Token);
```

**Verification:** Force a navigation failure after the email HTML has been created and check that the outgoing previewer is disposed after its browser source is cleared. Also verify successful email-to-email navigation and early parse failures. Keep deletion's existing IO/access-error handling; source clearing is not a claim that WebView file handles are synchronously released.

confidence.rationale: Pinned upstream control-flow proves the post-navigation-error replacement bypasses IDisposable while normal item changes call it. The exact owner replacement built independently and combined with the email-lifetime correction, preserving the original BOM. This is source/control-flow and compile validation; actual WebView failure/handle-release timing was not exercised without UI.

actions.note: Three coordinated inline suggestions form one atomic fix; the separate general PR comment covers the unchanged fallback owner.
